digest.component_or_area: CI workflows – GitHub Actions tickets-store fetch optimization
propositions: CI workflow fetch-paths must apply blob:none filter to reduce tickets-store transfer cost from multi-gigabyte full clones to sub-100 MiB partial clones and fetch time from minutes to seconds.

Standalone verify-identity and Gerrit verify-identity workflows must declare and enforce pack-size guardrails (102400 KiB and 131072 KiB respectively) to reject unfiltered regressions and validate actual protocol negotiation with git daemon.

Named-remote partial-clone inheritance and explicit --filter=blob:none on direct URL fetches must negotiate filter capability, send blob:none requests, leave known large blobs missing pre-materialization, and retain complete commit history for merge-base operations.

Materialization via git worktree add and identity scanning must preserve exact git count-objects state without introducing additional promisor objects or fetching missing blobs during identity verification.
Blobless tickets reconciliation must support independent local/remote changes, merge with ours driver, retain all expected events, and push successfully without full blob fetches.

Production acceptance requires parsed workflow validation, real-Git protocol tracing, size-guard execution against threshold-calibrated repositories, and end-to-end workflow execution with before/after object-store invariants.
